LESSON: SELF- AWARENESS IN THE COMMUNITY

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 10
Subject: COMMUNITY SERVICE LEARNING
Strand: Life Skills in Education
Topic 2.1: Self- Awareness in the Community
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 3

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Self- Awareness in the Community, part of Life Skills in Education in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 10 COMMUNITY SERVICE LEARNING.

Key inquiry question: Why is public self-awareness important? 2. How can I improve my public self- awareness?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. use digital or print resources to search and discuss the i) meaning of, and ii) factors that influence ‘public self- awareness.’ Learners with manipulation difficulties could use alternative functional parts of the body, use adapted digital devices, assistive technology or be assisted,

2. discuss the importance of public-image (mannerisms, expressive qualities and decisions) and make presentations in class. Learners with speech 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. use digital or print resources to search and discuss the i) meaning of, and ii) factors that influence ‘public self- awareness.’ Learners with manipulation difficulties could use alternative functional parts of the body, use adapted digital devices, assistive technology or be assisted,
2. discuss the importance of public-image (mannerisms, expressive qualities and decisions) and make presentations in class. Learners with speech 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Self- Awareness in the Community together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Self-efficacy as the learner discusses the importance of public-image (mannerisms, expressive qualities and

decisions) and make presentations in class.

● Creativity as the learners writes articles on different personalities in society depicting how their public image has

worked for them and present in class.

19

Values:
● Respect is promoted as learners tell stories about themselves to their classmates, then respectively receive

feedback about their public image.

● Love is promoted as learners critique (with guidance) selected personalities’ public image against their perceived

effectiveness in their roles.
